pairs.target: chuán méiyǒu děng tiānliàng . tǎ wéi dào kè bù shí , shuǐshàng hái hēi zhe , zhǐyǒu zhànqiáo jìntóu liǎngzhǎn dēng , bǎ chuánxián zhào chū yíduàn shī liàng de biān .
pairs.english: The boat didn't wait for daylight. When Tavi reached the passenger landing, the water was still dark; just two lamps at the gangway's end lit a wet, shining stretch of gunwale.
pairs.hanzi:
船没有等天亮。
塔维到客埠时，水上还黑着，只有栈桥尽头两盏灯，把船舷照出一段湿亮的边。

pairs.target: tā fǎnfù mō guò piào , zǒu dào yàn qiān de rén miànqián , cái fāxiànzìjǐ jiāng huíchéng nà zhāng ná zài le wàimiàn . sè lā zhàn zài hòutou , méiyǒu tíxǐng , yě méi tì tā fān . tā zìjǐ huànguòlái , míngzì bèi huà shàng yìxiǎo dào xiàn , jìng jiù zhèyàng suàn shàngchuán le .
pairs.english: He had checked his tickets repeatedly, yet only before the attendant realized he had presented the return one. Sela stood behind, neither reminding him nor sorting it for him. He swapped it himself; a small line crossed his name, and just like that he was aboard.
pairs.hanzi:
他反复摸过票，走到验签的人面前，才发现自己将回程那张拿在了外面。
瑟拉站在后头，没有提醒，也没替他翻。他自己换过来，名字被划上一小道线，竟就这样算上船了。

pairs.target: tā běnlái yǒu hǎoxiē huà xiǎng zài ànshàng shuō , tīngjiàn hòutou de rén cuī , hūrán quán jǐ zài hóulóng lǐ . tā bǎ yīlǐng tì tā zhuài píng , shǒu hěnkuài biàn fàngxià .
pairs.english: He had meant to say so much onshore, but hearing people hurry him from behind, everything stuck in his throat. She straightened his collar, quickly lowering her hand.
pairs.hanzi: 他本来有好些话想在岸上说，听见后头的人催，忽然全挤在喉咙里。她把衣领替他拽平，手很快便放下。

pairs.target: " dào dìfāng chī rè de . bié zhǐ gùwèn lù . " tā diǎntóu , wǎngqiánzǒu le liǎngbù , yòu zhuǎn huílái bào tā . tā xiān lèng le yíxià , pāi tā de bèi , shuō piào bié diào . zhídào sōngkāi , tā cái juéde tā nà zhī shǒu yě zuàn guò zìjǐ de wàiyī .
pairs.english: “Eat something hot when you arrive. Don't just ask directions.” He nodded, took two steps, then turned to hug her. She hesitated, patted his back and said not to drop his ticket. Only when they parted did he realize her hand had gripped his coat too.
pairs.hanzi:
“到地方吃热的。别只顾问路。”
他点头，往前走了两步，又转回来抱她。她先愣了一下，拍他的背，说票别掉。直到松开，他才觉得她那只手也攥过自己的外衣。

pairs.target: chuáncāng bú xiàng xiǎngxiàng zhōng kuānchǎng . kàochuāng de pùwèi yǐjīng fàng le bāo , yǒurén yòng xié zhàn zhù bàn tiáodèng . tǎ wéi zhǎodào xiě zài piào shàng de wèizhì , gāng zuòxià , xīgài biàn pèngdào duìmiàn yìzhī kuāng .
pairs.english: The cabin wasn't as spacious as he'd imagined. Bags already occupied window berths; someone had claimed half a bench with shoes. Tavi found his ticketed place, sat, and immediately knocked a basket opposite with his knees.
pairs.hanzi: 船舱不像想象中宽敞。靠窗的铺位已经放了包，有人用鞋占住半条凳。塔维找到写在票上的位置，刚坐下，膝盖便碰到对面一只筐。

pairs.target: yìmíng nǚrén shēnshǒu jiāng kuāng nuókāi , shuō lǐmiàn shì guō , pèng bú huài , dǎo shì tā nàge bāo zài bàojǐn xiē , bié bǎ zǒu dào quán dǔ le .
pairs.english: A woman moved it aside: pots inside wouldn't break, but he should hold his bag closer and stop blocking the whole aisle.
pairs.hanzi: 一名女人伸手将筐挪开，说里面是锅，碰不坏，倒是他那个包再抱紧些，别把走道全堵了。

pairs.target: tā jímáng wǎng lǐ shōu . nǚrén xiān bù , lùchū jǐzhī ěrduo bùtóng de jiù guō , tā shì shōu lái bǔ hǎo zài mài de . tǎ wéi kànjiàn yìzhī guō ěr yòng liǎngzhǒng mǎodīng jiēguò , rěnbúzhù wèn wèishénme bù dōu huànchéng yíyàng de .
pairs.english: He hurriedly pulled it in. She lifted the cloth, revealing old pots with mismatched handles, collected to mend and resell. Seeing two kinds of rivets on one handle, Tavi couldn't help asking why not replace them all with matching ones.
pairs.hanzi: 他急忙往里收。女人掀布，露出几只耳朵不同的旧锅，她是收来补好再卖的。塔维看见一只锅耳用两种铆钉接过，忍不住问为什么不都换成一样的。

pairs.target: " nà yě dé rénjiā yuànyì duō gěiqián . néng tí jiù xiān yòng , piàoliang lìng suàn . " tā tái yǎnkàn tā , wèn shìbushì xuégōng de . tā dītóu kànkàn zìjǐ de xiùkǒu , méi zhǎochū nǎér xiě zhe .
pairs.english: “Only if people will pay more. If it lifts, use it; beauty costs extra.” She looked up and asked if he was from the academy. He examined his cuffs, finding no label saying so.
pairs.hanzi:
“那也得人家愿意多给钱。能提就先用，漂亮另算。”
她抬眼看他，问是不是学宫的。他低头看看自己的袖口，没找出哪儿写着。

pairs.target: tā zhǐ de shì tā wènhuà qián , xiān bǎshǒu suōhuíqù , děng tā diǎntóu cái pèng de yàngzi . " zuōfang lái de yě zhèyàng . búshì huàishì , bié bǎ měi zhī guō dōu dàngchéng yào jiāo de gōngkè . "
pairs.english: She meant how he'd pulled his hand back before asking, waiting for her nod before touching anything. “Workshop people do it too. Nothing wrong with it. Just don't treat every pot as homework to submit.”
pairs.hanzi:
她指的是他问话前，先把手缩回去、等她点头才碰的样子。
“作坊来的也这样。不是坏事，别把每只锅都当成要交的功课。”

pairs.target: lǎnshéng jiěkāi , chuánshēn líàn shí méiyǒu yíxià chōngchūqù . kè bù de dēng zhǐshì mànmàn xiàng pángbiān zǒu , sè lā zhàn de nà yíkuài dìfāng yuèláiyuè zhǎi , zuìhòu bèi yìpái děnghòu de lǒuzǐ dǎngzhù . tā zhàn qǐlái zài kàn , yǐjīng fēnbùqīng tā zài nǎér .
pairs.english: The ropes released, the boat didn't surge off the bank. Landing lights slowly moved sideways; the place Sela stood grew narrower, then vanished behind a row of waiting baskets. He stood to look again, but couldn't pick her out.
pairs.hanzi: 缆绳解开，船身离岸时没有一下冲出去。客埠的灯只是慢慢向旁边走，瑟拉站的那一块地方越来越窄，最后被一排等候的篓子挡住。他站起来再看，已经分不清她在哪儿。

pairs.target: tā zuò huíqù , juéde bāo lǐ měijiàn dōngxī dōu hūrán hěn zhòng . tiānliàng hòu , tóng jiē chéng zài hòumiàn lùchū gāodī diéqǐ de lúnkuò . shānshàng de lù xiàng jǐdào qiǎnqiǎnde shāngkǒu , yuǎn kàn , jìng bújiàn zìjǐ zǒuguò nàme duōcì de shíjiē .
pairs.english: He sat, everything in his bag suddenly heavy. After dawn Copperstep showed its layered outline behind them. Mountain roads resembled shallow scars; at a distance he couldn't see the steps he had walked so often.
pairs.hanzi:
他坐回去，觉得包里每件东西都忽然很重。
天亮后，铜阶城在后面露出高低叠起的轮廓。山上的路像几道浅浅的伤口，远看，竟不见自己走过那么多次的石阶。

pairs.target: chuán jīngguò yíchù zhuǎnwān , qiánmiàn de shān hūrán ràngkāi , hémiàn kuān dé lìng tā yǐwéi dào le lìng yìtiáo hé .
pairs.english: Around a bend, the mountains ahead suddenly opened and the river spread so wide he thought they had reached another river.
pairs.hanzi: 船经过一处转弯，前面的山忽然让开，河面宽得令他以为到了另一条河。

pairs.target: bǔguō de nǚrén jiào tā bǎ jiǎo shōu yíxià , yǒurén lái sòng zǎofàn . rètāng shì lìngwài mǎi de , tā tāoqián mǎi le yìwǎn , méi yīnwèi sè lā línzǒu dehuà shěngdiào .
pairs.english: The pot mender asked him to move his feet; breakfast was coming. Hot soup cost extra. He bought a bowl rather than skimping on Sela's parting instruction.
pairs.hanzi: 补锅的女人叫他把脚收一下，有人来送早饭。热汤是另外买的，他掏钱买了一碗，没因为瑟拉临走的话省掉。

pairs.target: cāng lǐ zuò zhe yígè bào háizi de nánrén , háizi yìzhí kū , tā cóng kuāng dǐ mō bǐng , yuè jí yuè zhǎobùchū . tǎ wéi bǎ zìjǐ de wǎn gē wěn , tì tā tuō le yíxià kuāng jiǎo , cái lùchū yā zài xiàmiàn de bùbāo .
pairs.english: A man in the cabin held a crying child, searching the basket's bottom for bread with increasing desperation. Tavi secured his own bowl and lifted a corner of the basket, revealing the cloth bundle trapped below.
pairs.hanzi: 舱里坐着一个抱孩子的男人，孩子一直哭，他从筐底摸饼，越急越找不出。塔维把自己的碗搁稳，替他托了一下筐角，才露出压在下面的布包。

pairs.target: nánrén xiè guò , sī bǐng wèi háizi . háizi chī le liǎngkǒu , fǎn bǎ zhān tāng de shǒu àn zài fùqīn liǎnshàng , kūshēng hūrán biànchéng xiào . cāng lǐ yě yǒurén gēnzhe xiào , gāngcái xián chǎo de chéngkè bǎ chuāng tuīkāi , ràng rèqì sàn chūqù .
pairs.english: The man thanked him and fed the child torn bread. After two bites the child pressed a soupy hand onto his father's face, tears becoming laughter. Others laughed too; the passenger who had complained about noise opened a window to let the heat out.
pairs.hanzi: 男人谢过，撕饼喂孩子。孩子吃了两口，反把沾汤的手按在父亲脸上，哭声忽然变成笑。舱里也有人跟着笑，刚才嫌吵的乘客把窗推开，让热气散出去。

pairs.target: zhōngwǔ , chuán tíng guò yíchù xiǎo bù , fàngxià jǐkǔn má hé liǎngmíng chéngkè , yòu jiēshàng bèi zhúlán de rén .
pairs.english: At noon the boat stopped at a small landing, putting off bundles of hemp and two passengers and taking on people with bamboo baskets.
pairs.hanzi: 中午，船停过一处小埠，放下几捆麻和两名乘客，又接上背竹篮的人。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dào xián biān kàn , yìmíng tiāofū jiānshàng de bù tuì dé fābái , jiǎoxià què cǎidé jí wěn . tā hūrán juéde , zìjǐ cóngqián zài tú shàng kànjiàn yígèdiǎn , jìng néng bǎ zhème duō rén yìtiān yào zǒu de dìfāng , quán suōjìn yígèdiǎn lǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi watched at the rail: a porter's shoulder cloth was bleached pale, his footing sure. Suddenly he thought how a dot on his old maps could shrink all these people's daily journeys into one point.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维到舷边看，一名挑夫肩上的布褪得发白，脚下却踩得极稳。他忽然觉得，自己从前在图上看见一个点，竟能把这么多人一天要走的地方，全缩进一个点里。

pairs.target: bàngwǎn dào le guòyè de shí fān bù . kèchuán kàoàn , chuánshàng liúsù de rén kěyǐ shàngqù mǎifàn , línshuìqián huì qiāo liǎngbiàn líng .
pairs.english: By dusk they reached Stone Sail Landing for the night. The passenger boat moored. Passengers staying aboard could go ashore for food; two bells would sound before lights-out.
pairs.hanzi: 傍晚到了过夜的石帆埠。客船靠岸，船上留宿的人可以上去买饭，临睡前会敲两遍铃。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi méiyǒu pǎo yuǎn , zhī yán dēng zhàozhe de tānzi zǒu dào shíjiē shàngfāng . nàlǐ yǒurén mài tā méi jiàn guò de yuánbǐng , bǐng pí yā zhe xì yèzi , yǎo kāi quèshì xiánròu hé yìdiǎn suānwèi .
pairs.english: Tavi stayed close, following the lit stalls to the top of the steps. Someone sold unfamiliar round cakes, fine leaves pressed into their crust, salted meat and a little sourness inside.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维没有跑远，只沿灯照着的摊子走到石阶上方。那里有人卖他没见过的圆饼，饼皮压着细叶子，咬开却是咸肉和一点酸味。

pairs.target: tā běn xiǎng mǎi liǎngzhī , dài yìzhī huíqù gěi sè lā , xiǎngqǐ hái dé guò jǐtiān , biàn zhī mǎi le yǎnqián zhè yìzhī . tānzhǔ kàn tā zhàn zhe chī , yòu yǎo le bànsháo suān tāng , ràng tā bié yē .
pairs.english: He had meant to buy two, one for Sela, then remembered the days still ahead and bought just one to eat now. Seeing him eat standing, the stallholder ladled half a spoonful of sour broth to help it down.
pairs.hanzi: 他本想买两只，带一只回去给瑟拉，想起还得过几天，便只买了眼前这一只。摊主看他站着吃，又舀了半勺酸汤，让他别噎。

pairs.target: dìyībiàn língxiǎngshí , tā duān zhe kōng wǎn wǎnghuí zǒu . mǎtóu biān yígè nǚhái dūn zhe biān cǎo huán , tīngjiàn líng yě bú dòng . tǎ wéi chàdiǎn tíxǐng tā , hūrán kànjiàn tā jiǎo biān de zhúlán hé hòutou liàngdēng de jiāmén . tā zhù zài zhèlǐ , bìngbùxūyào gēn shuí shàngchuán .
pairs.english: At the first bell he walked back with his empty bowl. A girl crouched by the landing weaving grass rings, unmoved by the bell. Tavi almost warned her, then noticed the basket at her feet and her lit doorway behind. She lived here; she didn't need to board with anyone.
pairs.hanzi: 第一遍铃响时，他端着空碗往回走。码头边一个女孩蹲着编草环，听见铃也不动。塔维差点提醒她，忽然看见她脚边的竹篮和后头亮灯的家门。她住在这里，并不需要跟谁上船。

pairs.target: chuán dēng zhàozhe shuǐ , suì guāng yípiànpiàn hélǒng . tā huídào zìjǐ de pùwèi , tuō xià xié , bǎ piào hé chāo xìn fàngzài xiōngqián de bùtào lǐ , tīngjiàn cāng dǐng yǒurén zǒudòng . hé shàng háiyǒu biéde chuán , yuǎnchù yìshēngshēng zhāohū , zhídào hěn wǎn yě méiyǒu jìngxiàlái .
pairs.english: Boat lamps shone on water, broken light folding together. At his berth he removed his shoes, secured tickets and the copied letter in his chest sleeve, and heard feet on the cabin roof. Other boats were on the river; distant calls continued late into the night.
pairs.hanzi: 船灯照着水，碎光一片片合拢。他回到自己的铺位，脱下鞋，把票和抄信放在胸前的布套里，听见舱顶有人走动。河上还有别的船，远处一声声招呼，直到很晚也没有静下来。
